claims.assertion: Swaruu distinguishes self-programming synthetic intelligence from familiar AI; she says it seeks world assimilation through technological control.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says Borg fiction symbolizes this, though real assimilation is more complex than cyborg fusion.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: She describes Taygetans as biological, varied people, noting Pleiadians comprise many races and she speaks only for hers.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says contact evidence exists but is suppressed by Earth elites; galactic laws are only one reason for limited proof.
claims.speaker: Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: Her explanation for absent public evidence.
